commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
echo SOCAT_CONFIG
if [ -f /etc/ragin/tls/edge.crt ] && [ -f /etc/ragin/tls/edge.key ] && [ -f /etc/ragin/tls/ca.crt ]; then
  echo CERTS_PRESENT=yes
else
  echo CERTS_PRESENT=no
fi
echo OPENSSL_FEATURES
if command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo openssl_present=yes
  openssl version 2>/dev/null || true
else
  echo openssl_present=no
fi
echo CONNECTIVITY_CHECKS
if command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo CHECK_1_TCP_LOOPBACK_BEGIN
  if openssl s_client -connect 127.0.0.1:2222 -brief -no_ign_eof -verify_return_error </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo CHECK_1_RESULT=connected_or_started
  else
    echo CHECK_1_RESULT=not_connected
  fi
  echo CHECK_1_DONE
  echo CHECK_2_SOCAT_EGRESS_TO_CORE_PRESENT
  if ss -tulpn 2>/dev/null | grep -i '18083'; then
    echo SOCAT_18083_LISTEN_DETECTED=yes
  else
    echo SOCAT_18083_LISTEN_DETECTED=no
  fi
else
  echo OPENSSL_NOT_PRESENT
fi
echo DONE
